== Summary ==
Slip “•Launching The Assault” cut unchanged from page 3 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 26 December 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 790, 581, 1074)). Version [[Launching The Assault (V)|Launching The Assault (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
